title: Location Tracking & GPS Privacy Risk Calculator
metaDescription: Calculate your location privacy risk score. Assess how apps and services track your GPS data and get personalized tips to protect your location.
description: Evaluate your location privacy exposure across devices, apps, and services. This calculator analyzes your GPS tracking risk factors and provides actionable steps to protect your physical location data from unwanted surveillance.

inputs.helpText: Check your phone's location permissions to count apps with access

inputs.label: Location services accuracy setting
inputs.helpText: Found in your device's location/privacy settings

outputFields.description: Your overall location tracking risk level (0-100)

formula: const appRisk = Math.min(mobileApps * 2, 40); const accuracyRisk = locationAccuracy === 'high' ? 20 : locationAccuracy === 'low' ? 10 : 0; const socialRisk = socialSharing === 'always' ? 15 : socialSharing === 'sometimes' ? 8 : 0; const googleRisk = googleTracking ? 15 : 0; const adRisk = adTracking ? 10 : 0; const deviceRisk = Math.min(smartDevices * 2, 20); const wifiRisk = wifiTracking ? 10 : 0; const publicWifiRisk = publicWifi === 'daily' ? 15 : publicWifi === 'weekly' ? 10 : publicWifi === 'monthly' ? 5 : 0; const riskScore = Math.min(appRisk + accuracyRisk + socialRisk + googleRisk + adRisk + deviceRisk + wifiRisk + publicWifiRisk, 100); const trackingVectors = (mobileApps > 0 ? 1 : 0) + (locationAccuracy !== 'off' ? 1 : 0) + (socialSharing !== 'never' ? 1 : 0) + (googleTracking ? 1 : 0) + (adTracking ? 1 : 0) + (smartDevices > 0 ? 1 : 0) + (wifiTracking ? 1 : 0) + (publicWifi !== 'never' ? 1 : 0); let riskLevel, recommendation; if (riskScore <= 25) { riskLevel = 'A'; recommendation = 'Excellent privacy! Consider using Incognito Browser for additional web browsing privacy.'; } else if (riskScore <= 50) { riskLevel = 'B'; recommendation = 'Good privacy. Review app permissions and disable location for unnecessary apps.'; } else if (riskScore <= 75) { riskLevel = 'C'; recommendation = 'Moderate risk. Turn off Google Location History and limit social media location sharing.'; } else { riskLevel = 'D'; recommendation = 'High risk! Disable precise location services and review all app permissions immediately.'; } return { riskScore, riskLevel, trackingVectors, recommendation };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates multiple location tracking vectors including app permissions, device settings, social media habits, and connected devices. Each factor is weighted based on its privacy impact and data collection potential. The risk score reflects how extensively your location data may be collected, stored, and potentially shared.
tips: Regularly audit app location permissions - remove access for apps that don't need it
Turn off Google Location History and Timeline in your Google Account settings
Use 'Precise Location' sparingly - many apps work fine with approximate location
Disable location-based ads in your device's privacy settings
Turn off WiFi and Bluetooth when not needed to prevent beacon tracking
Use Incognito Browser to prevent location-based web tracking
Avoid checking in or tagging locations on social media
Review smart device privacy settings and disable unnecessary location features
